S001.people: Two young women standing beside a dark sedan on a lawn; a young man in a white shirt and dark trousers standing at right beside a golf bag
S001.event: Gathering outside a house before an outing; car loaded, golf clubs propped at right
S001.date_evidence: Orange in-camera date stamp burned into the lower right of the print reads '00. 5.14' (last digit slightly soft, either 5.14 or 5.11) = May 2000; heavy green foliage matches mid-May
S001.notes: Faces are small and turned away, so this is context rather than a portrait. Worth keeping because the burned-in stamp anchors the whole earliest run of this batch to spring 2000, earlier than the 2003 start given in the family brief.

S002.people: The young man of the couple (buzzed blond hair) alone, in a blue-and-white varsity/letterman jacket and baggy jeans
S002.event: Putting golf balls on the carpet of a living room, indoors
S002.date_evidence: Orange date stamp on the left edge of the print with the year digits '00' legible and the rest unreadable; blue-and-white varsity jacket and very baggy jeans place him in high school, same jacket as S013
S002.notes: A quiet solo frame of him as a teenager in his letterman jacket, indoor putting practice in a lamp-lit living room. Useful as a 'who he was before' cutaway.

S003.people: The couple, both in formal dress: she in a blue halter gown with an updo, he in a pale blue-grey formal suit with a white boutonniere
S003.event: Posed portrait before a school formal / prom, in a living room in front of a floral upholstered chair
S003.date_evidence: Orange in-camera date stamp reads clearly '00. 5.10' = 10 May 2000; the boutonniere, the pastel formal suit and the May date are textbook prom
S003.notes: The earliest hard-dated picture of the two of them together in this batch, and the only formal-dress portrait of them as teenagers. The stamp '00. 5.10' predates the 2003 start date given in the brief, so this pair evidently goes back to high school.

S004.people: Two young women and the young man of the couple crammed into the back of a car or van, laughing
S004.event: Piled into a vehicle at a party; a red plastic cup and a bottle in hand
S004.date_evidence: No stamp; teenage faces matching the stamped 2000 frames, striped rugby-style polo and the vehicle interior of the period
S004.notes: Loud, happy group snapshot with flash blowout. The woman of the couple is not clearly identifiable here, so it reads as a friends frame.

S005.people: Distant field-hockey/lacrosse players in kilts and jerseys; no one identifiable
S005.event: A girls' lacrosse/field-hockey match seen from the sideline, cars parked along the treeline
S005.date_evidence: Faint orange date stamp lower right, legible as '00. 5.1?' = May 2000; same camera and same season as the stamped field frames S006 and S014
S005.notes: Nobody is recognisable at this distance. Only value is as establishing footage for the high-school sports thread that S006 and S014 belong to.

S006.people: The couple at a sports field; she in a white team jersey holding a lacrosse stick, he in a white t-shirt with an arm around her
S006.event: He has come to watch her game; posed together on the sideline with the teams warming up behind
S006.date_evidence: Vertical orange date stamp on the left edge reads '00. 4.23' = 23 April 2000; bare trees and brown grass confirm early spring
S006.notes: Hard-dated to 23 April 2000 and shows the two of them alone, in her team uniform, at the very start of the relationship. Same roll and same day as S014.

S007.people: The couple; she in a pale blue slip dress, he in a grey t-shirt flexing an arm and holding a red cup
S007.event: Clowning for the camera at a party or after a dance
S007.date_evidence: No stamp; severely faded and fogged print with a heavy sepia cast (badly stored film print), and both look the same teenage age as the stamped 2000 frames
S007.notes: The print is the most damaged in the batch - almost entirely bleached to brown with a fog band across the top. Still readable as the two of them alone, mugging for the lens.

S008.people: The couple embracing in front of a white panelled door; she in a white knit top and jeans, he in a black polo
S008.event: Posed hug indoors before going out, dressed up for an evening
S008.date_evidence: Vertical orange date stamp on the left edge, year digits '00' and a month '5' legible, day unreadable; her white knit top and his black polo also appear in S009, so the two are the same evening
S008.notes: A clean, well-lit, straight-on portrait of the couple alone - one of the sharper prints in the batch. Same night as S009.

S009.people: The couple indoors; she in the same white knit top laughing, he standing behind her
S009.event: Candid laughing moment in a kitchen or dining room, plants in the foreground
S009.date_evidence: Faint orange date stamp at lower right (digits too degraded to read fully); matching clothing to S008, which carries a legible '00' year stamp
S009.notes: Unposed and genuinely funny - she is doubled over laughing while he grins behind her. Foreground plant leaves intrude into the frame.

S010.people: The couple leaning against an exterior wall, faces pressed together, laughing
S010.event: Horseplay outside a building, both in black tops
S010.date_evidence: No stamp and no legible signage; print is scanned at a steep angle with a heavy orange light-leak stain across the lower half, so only the apparent young ages of the two can be used
S010.notes: Badly framed, tilted and stained by a light leak, but still the two of them alone and clearly delighted. Genuinely cannot date this one beyond 'early'.

S011.people: The couple on striped beach loungers; he in a bucket hat and blue floral swim shorts with a drink, she in a blue bikini
S011.event: A day on a crowded resort beach, palms and beach umbrellas behind, storm clouds overhead
S011.date_evidence: No stamp; palms and lifeguard-style resort beach point to a Florida trip, and both look a few years older than the stamped 2000 frames; bucket hat and long floral board shorts fit the early 2000s
S011.notes: Their first holidays together as a couple - relaxed, drinks in hand, on matching loungers. Probably the same trip as S032, S034, S035 and S040.

S012.people: The couple outdoors at dusk; he in a navy 'Pike 1868' t-shirt and a backwards Yankees cap, she in a grey hooded sweatshirt
S012.event: Arm-in-arm portrait outdoors under trees, late afternoon light
S012.date_evidence: His shirt reads 'Pike 1868', the Pi Kappa Alpha fraternity, which places this in his college years rather than high school; both look older than the stamped 2000 prom frame
S012.notes: Warm backlit portrait of the couple alone, both beaming - technically one of the better prints here. The fraternity shirt is the useful dating clue: college era.

S013.people: The couple indoors; he in the blue-and-white varsity jacket and baggy jeans, she in a navy sweatshirt, arms around each other
S013.event: Posed together in a living room in front of a dresser with flowers and bottles
S013.date_evidence: He wears the identical blue-and-white varsity jacket seen in S002, which carries a '00' date stamp; the room and lamp match S002 as well
S013.notes: High-school-era couple portrait, him still in his letterman jacket. Ties directly to the stamped 2000 material through the jacket and the room.

S014.people: The couple on the sports field, facing each other; her back to camera in a white jersey numbered 11, he in a white t-shirt pulling a face
S014.event: Joking around on the sideline of her lacrosse game, teams lined up in the background
S014.date_evidence: Orange in-camera date stamp at lower right reads clearly '00. 4.23' = 23 April 2000; bare trees behind confirm April
S014.notes: Hard-dated 23 April 2000 and completely unposed - he is gurning at her mid-conversation with her number 11 filling the frame. Same day as S006.

S015.people: The couple hugging at a party, both in white t-shirts; he holds a printed flyer
S015.event: A themed house party - a large carnival/circus-style painted banner is pinned to the wall behind them, plastic jug of drink on the counter
S015.date_evidence: No date stamp; the hand-painted party banner text is not legible enough to name the event; ages suggest a year or two after the 2000-stamped frames
S015.notes: Classic student-party frame with the couple alone in the middle of it. The banner behind would be identifiable to the family even though I cannot read it.

S016.people: The couple hugging in the front seat of a car at night
S016.event: Wrapped around each other in a parked car, lit by flash
S016.date_evidence: No stamp or legible detail; only the car interior and their apparent early-twenties ages, slightly older than the 2000-stamped frames
S016.notes: Very tender - her eyes closed, both smiling, faces squeezed together. One of several car-seat frames (S020, S022, S023) that together read as a whole era of driving around.

S017.people: The couple outside at night; he shirtless holding a beer bottle, she in a white vest top with a bottle in hand
S017.event: Standing on a lawn outside a house at night during a summer party
S017.date_evidence: No stamp; the print is fogged and low-contrast, so only summer clothing and their young appearance are usable
S017.notes: Heavy green fog across the whole print from age or a flash misfire. Still an honest record of a summer night in their early twenties.

S018.people: The couple in front of a heavy dark wooden door; she in a white vest top with wet, sun-lightened hair, he in a pale t-shirt
S018.event: Posed together at the entrance to a house or restaurant, both sunburnt and just out of the water
S018.date_evidence: No stamp; her hair is markedly lighter and both are tanned, suggesting one of the summer/holiday rolls rather than the school-year frames
S018.notes: Simple, well-exposed two-shot against a striking carved door. I cannot place the location from anything visible.

S019.people: The couple sitting together on a dark leather sofa, she in a black vest, he in a white t-shirt and blue shorts
S019.event: An evening in at an apartment - acoustic guitar propped in the corner, stacked cases of drinks by the wall, TV remote in hand
S019.date_evidence: No stamp; the setting is a sparsely furnished flat of their own (bare walls, cases of drink stacked on the floor, one floor lamp) rather than a family home, which suggests their first shared place
S019.theme: Home; Everyday life; The life we built
S019.notes: One of the very few frames showing an actual home interior of their own - the empty walls and stacked cases say early, unfurnished first apartment. Good 'the life we built' opener.

S020.people: The couple in a car; he twisted round from the front seat pulling a face, she in a white headband laughing
S020.event: Messing about in a parked car in daylight
S020.date_evidence: No stamp; her wide white headband and his short spiked hair fit the early 2000s, and both look early twenties
S020.notes: Pure goofing - his tongue-out grin and her open laugh. Part of the car-seat cluster with S016, S022 and S023.

S022.people: The couple in a car, both in white caps; she wearing glasses at the wheel, he leaning into frame from below
S022.event: About to drive somewhere; self-taken arm's-length snapshot in the car
S022.date_evidence: No stamp; arm's-length film self-portrait (pre-smartphone), matching caps and her wire-frame glasses fit the early 2000s
S022.notes: An arm's-length selfie taken on film, which is itself a period marker - they had to pay to find out it worked. Both grinning straight down the lens.

S023.people: The couple in a car at night; he in a bright turquoise polo at the wheel, she in a strappy top turning back from the passenger seat
S023.event: Turning round to the camera in a parked car before a night out
S023.date_evidence: No stamp; both look dressed for an evening out and a little older than the 2000-stamped frames; nothing else datable in the car interior
S023.notes: Cleanly lit and both looking straight at the lens. Reads as the start of a night out.

S024.people: The couple in extreme close-up, lying head to head; he in a pale blue cap, she looking up at him
S024.event: Lying down together, faces filling the frame, both laughing
S024.date_evidence: No stamp and no background context at all - the frame is entirely faces; dated only by their apparent early-twenties ages
S024.notes: Grainy and slightly out of focus but emotionally the strongest kind of frame in the batch - the couple alone, entirely unguarded. No dating clues whatsoever.

S025.people: One person standing at the far side of the room; not identifiable
S025.event: Interior of a rustic wood-panelled restaurant or lodge, long table with a decorated centrepiece
S025.date_evidence: No stamp, no legible signage, no identifiable people; the print has also been scanned rotated 90 degrees
S025.notes: A place, not a moment, and scanned sideways. I genuinely cannot date or locate it.

S026.people: The couple kissing on a patterned sofa; he in a white vest and navy backwards cap, she in a white t-shirt leaning into him
S026.event: A quiet kiss on the sofa of a wood-panelled cabin or lake house
S026.date_evidence: No stamp; the room - wood panelling, red-trimmed lace curtains, southwestern-pattern sofa - is the same one as S028 and S029, and S027 is the exterior of the same building, so all four are one trip; ages suggest early twenties
S026.notes: The single most intimate frame in the batch: the two of them alone, mid-kiss, no audience, warm afternoon light through the curtain. Same weekend as S027, S028 and S029.

S027.event: Exterior of a red-trimmed timber cabin/lodge with a stone chimney, photographed through pine branches
S027.date_evidence: No stamp and no people; dated only by association - the red trim and window frames match the interior of S026, S028 and S029, so it is the same trip
S027.notes: Empty scenery, but it is the establishing shot for the cabin where the three best couple frames of that trip were taken. Keep it as a cutaway, not a hero.

S028.people: The couple on the same patterned sofa; he in a white vest and backwards cap laughing upward, she curled against his chest
S028.event: Lounging together on the cabin sofa, both laughing at something off-camera
S028.date_evidence: No stamp; identical clothing, sofa and curtains to S026 means this is minutes from that frame, and the cabin exterior is S027
S028.notes: The laughing companion frame to the kiss in S026 - she is folded into him with her hands clasped in his. Couple alone, well exposed.

S029.people: The couple on the cabin sofa; he in a black beanie and white t-shirt, she in a pale blue sweatshirt, each holding a glass of red wine
S029.event: Toasting with wine glasses in the cabin living room
S029.date_evidence: No stamp; same sofa, curtains and panelling as S026 and S028, but different clothes and a beanie, so a colder evening of the same stay
S029.notes: A wine toast, just the two of them, in a borrowed cabin - reads as one of their first trips away together. Print is slightly crooked with the curtain dominating the top third.

S031.people: The couple lying on a carpeted floor among confetti and beer cans, heads together, laughing
S031.event: The aftermath of a party - streamers and confetti all over the carpet, drum hardware and cymbal stands in the corner, cans on the side table
S031.date_evidence: No stamp; the drum stands, balloon and party debris also appear in S049, so the two are from the same night; no legible date cue beyond their young faces
S031.notes: Collapsed on the floor at the end of a party, still holding on to each other and laughing - the debris around them tells the whole story of the night. Same party as S049.

S032.people: Four young people posed on a brick walkway - two women and two men, arms around each other, one in a bucket hat
S032.event: Group holiday portrait in a tropical resort setting with palms and clipped hedges
S032.date_evidence: No stamp; palms, brick paving and resort landscaping point to the same Florida trip as S011, S034, S035 and S040; long board shorts and bucket hat fit the early 2000s
S032.notes: Standard holiday line-up in strong midday sun with hard shadows. Useful for showing who they travelled with in those years.

S034.people: The couple lying together on the settee inside a boat's cabin; she in a blue t-shirt, he beneath her grinning, striped cushions around them
S034.event: Below decks on a motor boat - varnished wood table, galley sink and fridge visible, a drinks can on the counter
S034.date_evidence: No stamp; bright tropical light through the windows and the boat interior tie this to the same warm-weather trip as S011, S032 and S035
S034.notes: Distinctive setting - a boat cabin - with the couple alone and clearly enjoying themselves. Rare location in this collection.

S035.people: Several unidentified people on a waterfront railing, including a child; none identifiable as the couple
S035.event: A waterfront promenade with ornate lamp posts, a city skyline across the water
S035.date_evidence: No stamp; the skyline is too hazy to identify a specific city, and the people are strangers; grouped with the holiday rolls by the tropical light and clothing
S035.notes: A view rather than a memory - the family are not in it. Fine as a location cutaway for the holiday sequence.

S036.people: The couple standing arm in arm in front of a yellow-sided house with a concrete stoop; a third person is cut off at the right edge
S036.event: Posed in front of a house - possibly their first place or a family home - he in an 'RLX' sweatshirt, she in a blue top and white zip jacket
S036.date_evidence: No stamp; the RLX/Polo sportswear branding and their slightly older faces put this later than the 2000-stamped frames; no house number or signage legible
S036.theme: Home; The life we built; Growing together
S036.notes: The couple alone in front of a house they clearly wanted photographed - the strongest 'home' candidate in these four sheets. I cannot confirm from the image whether it is their own first house.

S038.people: The couple lying together on a single bed, she in a blue top with her head on his chest, both looking at the camera
S038.event: In a dorm or student bedroom - the wall and floor are papered with beer and NFL posters (a Bud Light poster and a New York Giants poster are legible)
S038.date_evidence: The poster-covered dorm wall, cinderblock construction and door-mounted notice place this squarely in their college years; Bud Light and NY Giants posters are legible but not year-specific
S038.theme: Young love; Everyday life; Growing together
S038.notes: The most unmistakably 'college' frame in the batch - a narrow dorm bed and a wall of beer posters. Print scanned at an angle with a strong colour cast.

S039.people: The couple sunbathing in garden loungers; he shirtless in a white NY Giants cap and blue floral shorts, she in a pale blue bikini top on a pink towel, holding hands
S039.event: Sunbathing side by side on a back lawn, hands linked between the chairs
S039.date_evidence: No stamp; NFL (Giants) cap and long floral board shorts are early-2000s, and both look mid-twenties - a little older than the college frames
S039.theme: Young love; Everyday life; Growing together
S039.notes: Bright, sharp and warm, with their linked hands as the centre of the frame. Couple alone.

S040.people: The couple lying on towels in the middle distance on an empty beach
S040.event: A quiet day on a wide ocean beach, surf and flat horizon behind
S040.date_evidence: No stamp and no legible detail at this distance; grouped with the other beach/holiday rolls by film look and subject
S040.notes: They are tiny in a very wide frame, so it works as a mood/atmosphere shot rather than a portrait. Faces are not readable.

S041.people: The couple standing hand in hand on a path in front of a brick building; she in a black-and-white patterned top and cropped black trousers, he in a white short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers
S041.event: Dressed up and posed before a family occasion or graduation, in front of a brick building with planted borders
S041.date_evidence: No stamp; both look noticeably older and better dressed than the college frames, his hair is very short and hers is long and straightened - mid-2000s styling
S041.notes: Clean, sharp full-length portrait of the two of them, holding hands and dressed for an occasion. I cannot tell from the image what the occasion was; there is no ring clearly visible.

S045.people: A young woman in a red dress being carried upside down over a young man's shoulder; both faces are largely hidden, a third person's leg is in frame
S045.event: Party horseplay - she is hoisted upside down, laughing, on a patio or stone floor
S045.date_evidence: No stamp; the red bandeau dress with a wide sequinned belt and the beaded bracelets are mid-2000s going-out wear, but no faces are readable so I cannot confirm this is the couple
S045.notes: Visually striking and very funny, but I cannot identify anyone with confidence - both faces are obscured or upside down.

S047.people: Three young women and one young man in a cowboy hat, crowded together in a kitchen, drinks raised
S047.event: Clowning in a small apartment kitchen, one person's hand thrown up casting a shadow on the wall
S047.date_evidence: There IS an orange in-camera date stamp in the lower right, but it is too faint and blurred to resolve - only three separate digit groups are visible, not readable as a date
S047.notes: A friends frame; the woman of the couple may be the one at left but I cannot be certain from the angle. The date stamp is present but illegible even at maximum enlargement.

S048.people: About a dozen people at an outdoor watersports club - a young woman seated on a picnic bench, a man in a wetsuit and harness, an older man in a polo shirt walking past
S048.event: A day at a cable-ski or wakeboard park - buoyancy aids, harnesses and a yellow flag, portable buildings behind
S048.date_evidence: No stamp; no legible signage on the buildings; dated only loosely by the film look and clothing
S048.notes: Busy and documentary rather than personal - I cannot positively identify the couple in it. Good texture for an 'adventure' sequence.

S049.people: The couple kissing, lying down; her hair falling across his face, a small ring visible on her right hand resting on his shoulder
S049.event: A kiss on the floor at a party - a Coors/Bud Light can, a blue balloon and drum hardware are right beside them
S049.date_evidence: No stamp; the drum stands, balloon and beer cans match S031 exactly, so it is the same party; the ring on her right hand is a small stone ring, NOT a wedding or engagement set, consistent with the pre-marriage era
S049.notes: A completely private moment caught in the middle of a party - the couple alone, kissing, oblivious. Blown-out flash and grain, but the emotion carries it. Same night as S031.

S050.people: Four or five young people piled on top of each other on a bedroom floor, laughing, one in a red bandana
S050.event: A dogpile in a student bedroom, shelves and posters behind
S050.date_evidence: No stamp; low-rise jeans, bandana headscarf and the dorm-style shelving suggest the college years, but no specific cue
S050.notes: Chaotic and hard to read - limbs everywhere and the print scanned at an angle. Good for a fast montage of the friend group, not as a hero.

S051.people: The couple in close-up at a party; she in a white halter top with hoop earrings and a wristwatch, he leaning his head against hers
S051.event: Posed cheek to cheek at a night-time party or bar, dark background
S051.date_evidence: No stamp; halter neck top, chunky hoop earrings and her straightened hair are mid-2000s going-out styling, and both look mid-twenties
S051.notes: Big, open smiles from both of them against a clean dark background - one of the most usable close-up portraits of the couple in the batch.

S052.people: The couple standing formally in a dim room; she in a short white dress, he in a light shirt and tie
S052.event: Dressed for a formal event - a chandelier and a small table with an ornament behind them, likely a hotel or function room
S052.date_evidence: Formal dress and tie but NO wedding gown, veil, boutonniere or bouquet, so this is not their wedding; the print is very dark and underexposed so I can read little else
S052.notes: Badly underexposed - the couple occupy a small part of a mostly empty dark frame. Probably the same formal night as S054, given the dress-and-tie combination.

S054.people: The couple in a crowded bar or function room, he in shirt and tie raising a beer bottle, she in a strapless dark dress with a white corsage; several other guests around them
S054.event: A dance or reception - the corsage on her dress and the ties on the men indicate a formal function, and drinks are being raised
S054.date_evidence: Her white wrist/dress corsage plus ties on multiple men points to a formal dance or someone else's wedding reception; she is NOT in a bridal gown, so this is not their own wedding
S054.notes: Dark, blurred and shot into a crowd, but it records a formal night out together with friends. The corsage is the clearest evidence of the occasion.

S055.people: The couple sitting together in a student bedroom; she in a lilac top holding a can, he in a white vest and backwards navy bandana/cap with a glass
S055.event: Hanging out in a dorm room - desk, bookshelf, corkboard with photos and papers, computer speakers behind them
S055.date_evidence: The room is unmistakably a college dorm (institutional shelving, corkboard of pinned photos, desk lamp, CRT-era desk kit), placing this in their student years
S055.notes: A relaxed, ordinary evening in his dorm room - exactly the sort of everyday scene nobody thinks to photograph twice. Couple alone.

S056.people: The couple in close-up at a bar; she in a turquoise strapless top with a pendant, he in a bright blue dress shirt and patterned tie
S056.event: Cheek to cheek at a bar or reception, neon signage glowing behind them, other guests visible
S056.date_evidence: Shirt and tie on him plus a strapless going-out top on her suggests a formal night out (possibly the same event as S054); no stamp and no legible signage
S056.notes: Both faces are sharp, well lit and genuinely happy - one of the better couple close-ups here. Not a wedding: no gown, veil or bridal party visible.

S057.people: The couple standing outdoors by a pine tree; he in a pale blue dress shirt and dark trousers, she in a black halter dress with a beaded belt and necklace
S057.event: Posed together outside before a formal event, his arms around her waist
S057.date_evidence: Dressed formally but with no bridal gown, veil, boutonniere or bouquet, so not their wedding; the beaded low-slung belt and halter dress are mid-2000s styling; his hair is longer here than in the buzz-cut frames
S057.notes: A proper full-length couple portrait in natural light, both dressed up and clearly pleased with each other - probably taken before a wedding or dance they were attending. Sharper than most prints in this batch.
